Subject: MAP: SOC 2 package delivery and security review - Aurelia Tech

Hi Jordan 
- great to meet earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery + proposed MAP draft for the security review milestone.

Recap (30 min call):
- Use case: document understanding + customer support triage; latency and data isolation are key.
- Primary security ask: SOC 2 artifacts + questionnaire, network controls, data retention policy.
- Timeline: Aurelia aims to complete security review and procurement in July to hit an August pilot.

Proposed MAP milestone: Security review / SOC 2 package delivery
- Target close date: 2026-07-20 (MAP: procurement + security sign-off)
- Redwood responsibilities:
  - Complete and return SOC 2 questionnaire (doc attached) 
  - target 2026-07-02 (Owner: Marissa Cole)
  - Provide evidence bundle (logs, config screenshots, SOC 2 report pointer, KMS config summary) 
  - target 2026-07-07 (Owner: Engineering via Aditya)
  - Offer a 60-min technical review session with security eng 
  - target week of 2026-07-12 (Owner: Marissa / Aditya)
- Aurelia responsibilities:
  - Confirm evidence acceptance and schedule security review call 
  - target 2026-07-12 (Owner: Jordan)
  - Complete procurement paperwork / PO approval 
  - target 2026-07-20 (Owner: Lena Ortiz)
- Dependencies:
  - Redwood needs access to share redacted logs and a copy of SOC 2 Type II report or auditor contact.
  - Aurelia needs to confirm acceptable evidence types (see evidence list attached).

Attachments: SOC2-Questionnaire-AureliaTech-20260628.docx, SOC2-Evidence-List-AureliaTech-20260628.xlsx, Mutual-Action-Plan-AureliaTech-20260628.pdf

Next steps / asks:
1) Jordan 
please confirm: is the proposed evidence list sufficient, and is the 2026-07-07 evidence delivery workable?
2) Can Lena confirm the internal procurement timeline so we can align target close date?
3) If yes, we'll lock the MAP in HubSpot (link below) and send a calendar invite for the technical review.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HT-8429

Hi Marissa - thanks for the recap and draft MAP. Quick answers and a couple of notes from our side.

- Timeline: 2026-07-07 for evidence delivery is tight but feasible if Redwood can provide the majority of the bundle by 2026-07-02 and we have time to review. Our internal target is to complete security review by 2026-07-15 so procurement can finalize by 2026-07-22.
- Questionnaire: we will start reviewing the attached questionnaire today. Please confirm if you prefer the DOCX returned or a PDF with embedded comments.
- Evidence: we need the evidence list populated with links or packaged artifacts where possible. For logs/configs we prefer redacted screenshots + signed attestations.

Also looping Lena so procurement is aware of proposed dates. Lena - are those timelines compatible with your approval windows?

Next steps from Aurelia:
1) We­ll confirm acceptable evidence types by 2026-07-01.
2) We­ll aim to complete our internal security review by 2026-07-15.
